historical_reviews.deepseek: Not sufficient: loaded modules and probe logs do not prove MST enumeration or a correctly looped physical port state.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores manual loopback coverage, explicit port/cable/state mapping, safe isolation and recovery while retaining automatable evidence collection.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row62 observes Ethernet LEDs; it cannot replace this row's all-port MST and InfiniBand physical-state validation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Manual topology changes remain operator-owned and require independent recovery plus case-specific evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify all approved MLNX devices enumerate correctly in MST and every intended port reaches its specified physical/operational state when connected through the approved loopback arrangement.
original_method: A qualified operator sequentially applies mapped loopbacks to isolated ports while the agent records complete MST inventory, ibstat port and physical state, link/fabric health and recovery before, during and after each connection.
manual_activity: User approves port/state matrix and isolation; qualified operator installs/removes each approved loopback; agent performs only read-only MST/ibstat/link/health collection.
required_inputs: Every MLNX device/BDF/serial/PSID and physical-port map
Approved loopback cable/transceiver or peer procedure and port order
Expected MST identity plus ibstat State and Physical state per port
Confirmation that no management/BMC/storage/production fabric path is disturbed
Qualified operator, MFT/MST and IB tools, secure access, independent recovery and protected evidence
safety_requirements: Validate port, cable/transceiver compatibility and isolation before connection
Keep independent management/OOB access and change one mapped port at a time
Stop on wrong port, unsafe cable, fabric/management impact, no link, MST/ibstat error or device log error
Preserve complete logs and operator actions; do not clear logs
Do not auto-reset ports, reboot, change topology, retry or claim physical work
agent_execution_scope: Collect per-port state and health after each operator loopback
Verify final restored topology and compare observed states with the approved matrix
Do not manipulate cables, infer loopback from modules, reset/reboot or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve port/cable/state matrix, isolation and recovery
Provide qualified operator and define acceptable state transitions/timeouts
Review complete per-port evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable to the required physical loopback proof: lsmod and filtered dmesg omit MST device inventory and ibstat per-port State/Physical state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect untruncated mst status -v and ibstat per mapped port before and after each operator-applied loopback, with link/fabric/log health and exact identity correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All MLNX ports, MST check, loopback, ibstat physical state, correct-information criterion and 10/10 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a controlled one-port-at-a-time physical loopback matrix with identity-locked MST and ibstat evidence plus restored-topology verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines operator ownership, expected states, isolation, evidence and abort/recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores the physical loopback and per-port states lost by DeepSeek's software-only check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Loopback behavior depends on port mode, cable/transceiver and firmware configuration; expected LinkUp/Active/Init state must be project-approved.

project_override_considerations: Project port mode and fabric topology determine the valid loopback hardware and expected ibstat state; neither can be inferred from module presence.
expected_evidence: Approval, operator identity and device/port/cable/state map
Complete before/per-port/after mst status -v and ibstat output
Loopback connection/removal notes or photos and transition timestamps
Link/fabric/management health plus complete system/SEL logs
Restored topology, comparison matrix and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's module/dmesg command does not exercise the Master's mandatory physical loopback or collect MST and ibstat per-port states; Master and GPT V2 retain authority.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is executable after project supplies operator, loopback hardware, state matrix and isolation; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores all-port physical loopback coverage and separates operator actions from secure automated state collection.
independent_technical_reasoning: A loaded mlx module only shows that a driver component is present; it does not prove that every MST device is mapped or that each physical port detects a loopback and reaches the expected InfiniBand state. Because connecting the wrong port can alter a live fabric, every observation must be tied to a stable device/port identity and operator action.
